metadata.description:
Nippo Lake Golf Club offers something for golfers of all levels. You will enjoy the majestic beauty of this backwoods links either playing golf, taking a lesson, or just taking a few practice swings on the driving range. The serene setting and friendly staff make you want to come back day after day. And when the day is done relax and dine in Chip and Run Pub & Grill.
It is our sincere desire to provide you with a place where you can gather and experience the warmth of friendship, the friendly spirit of competition and a cozy atmosphere in which to relax and dine!

metadata.description:
Sagamore-Hampton Golf Club opened for play in 1962 as the Seacoast’s first public daily-fee golf course. With more than 40 years of experience, Sagamore-Hampton GC works very hard to offer great conditions, great values in rates and a fun atmosphere to all golfers. The family’s fourth generation is extremely dedicated to making Sagamore one of the best golf values in New Hampshire.

Sagamore-Hampton GC is an ideal golf experience no matter what your ability may be. All generations from children to grandparents can enjoy this course. Fairways are generous and greens are receptive, making it enjoyable for everyone.
